calls.title: Initiate
calls.eligibility: Founders at the ideation or pre-MVP stage
calls.quote: Initiate is Hub71’s early-stage programme that supports founders at the ideation or pre-MVP stage to turn their ideas into scalable startups.

calls.title: MZN x Hub71 Programme
calls.quote: The MZN x Hub71 Programme is a three-month programme powered by Hub71 in partnership with the Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development, designed to support Emirati founders in transforming innovative ideas into market-ready minimum viable products (MVPs).

calls.title: Hub71 Sandbox Programme
calls.quote: Access a guided track to trial your solution with regulators, validate it in real-world environments, and move towards market deployment.

calls.title: Hub71 Immersion Programme (India)
calls.quote: The Hub71 Immersion Programme is a structured, in-market experience designed to support international startups as they explore and build connections within Abu Dhabi’s global tech ecosystem.

calls.title: Access Programme
calls.quote: Get the support you need to take your business to the next level in Abu Dhabi. Our Access Program offers a comprehensive support package and a route into the UAE capital’s marketplace.

calls.title: ECA Anjal Z x Hub71
calls.eligibility: Startups addressing challenges across early childhood development
calls.quote: The ECA Anjal Z x Hub71 programme supports startups addressing challenges across early childhood development, from pregnancy through age eight, by providing direct access to government partners, pilot opportunities, and Hub71’s broader innovation ecosystem.

calls.title: Your gateway to SAVI
calls.quote: Hub71 is your startup’s gateway into Abu Dhabi’s SAVI cluster. Smart and autonomous mobility startups joining Hub71 gain direct access to SAVI’s network of partners, regulators and testing environments.

calls.title: Hub71+ Life Sciences
calls.eligibility: Startups in biotechnology, MedTech, and digital health
calls.quote: Hub71+ Life Sciences is Abu Dhabi’s specialist ecosystem driving innovation across biotechnology, MedTech, and digital health.

calls.title: Hub71+ Digital Assets
calls.eligibility: Web3 startups including blockchain and cryptocurrency startups
calls.quote: Hub71+ Digital Assets is a dedicated programme to promote Web3 startup growth from the heart of Abu Dhabi.

calls.title: Hub71+ ClimateTech
calls.eligibility: Sustainability startups leveraging technologies to drive decarbonization
calls.quote: Hub71+ ClimateTech is a specialist ecosystem, where sustainability startups leverage technologies to drive decarbonization in supporting a net zero future.

calls.title: Hub71+ AI
calls.eligibility: Startups at the forefront of AI innovation
calls.quote: Hub71+ AI is a specialist ecosystem designed to support startups at the forefront of AI innovation.

calls.title: Company Building Program
calls.quote: Company building program with flexible incentives
